claim_text: Unnecessary or excessive iron supplementation can cause gastrointestinal adverse effects and may be harmful in iron-overload conditions; existing intake and laboratory/clinical indication should be reviewed before adding iron.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.

population.other_context: People with known high iron intake or suspected iron overload.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Iron fact sheet describes adverse effects, upper limits and iron overload context.
limitations: No dose; do not recommend additional iron without indication.
Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
